Name: Vanilla Furnace Expanded
Author: Jejcofa
Description:
[size=6][b]Vanilla Furnace Expanded (VFE)[/b][/size]

A comprehensive, vanilla-friendly expansion for furnaces in [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b]. Adds upgraded Tiered Furnaces (Copper, Iron, Gold), alternative fuel recipes for the Charcoal Kiln, artifact smelting, and a mini fishing-meter progress bar floating above active furnaces.
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]⚡ Tiered Furnaces (Copper, Iron, Gold):[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Copper Furnace:[/b] Smelts [b]10% faster[/b]. Standard batch (5 ore + 1 coal → 1 bar). Warm copper aesthetic.[/*]
[*][b]Iron Furnace:[/b] Smelts [b]15% faster[/b] in double batches (10 ore + 2 coal → 2 bars, 2 quartz → 2 refined quartz).[/*]
[*][b]Gold Furnace:[/b] Smelts [b]20% faster[/b] in triple batches (15 ore + 3 coal → 3 bars, 3 quartz → 3 refined quartz).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🎣 Mini Progress Indicator:[/b]
[list]
[*] Displays a clean, miniature cast-meter progress bar directly above active furnaces and kilns.[/*]
[*]Fully toggleable via mod settings.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🪵 Alternative Charcoal Kiln Fuel:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turn surplus farm materials into Coal at the Charcoal Kiln:
[list]
[*] [b]Hardwood:[/b] 2 Hardwood → 1 Coal[/*]
[*][b]Fiber:[/b] 20 Fiber → 1 Coal[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🏺 Artifact Smelting:[/b]
[list]
[*] Melt down duplicate or useless museum artifacts into metal bars (requires 1 coal):
[list]
[*] [b]Copper Bar:[/b] Rusty Spoon, Rusty Spur, Rusty Cog.[/*]
[*][b]Iron Bar:[/b] Rare Disc, Ancient Sword, Anchor.[/*]
[*][b]Gold Bar:[/b] Dwarvish Helm, Dwarf Gadget, Golden Mask, Golden Relic.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size]

You can configure options in-game using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], or by editing the generated [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:
[list]
[*][b]ShowProgressBar:[/b] Show or hide the mini progress bar above working furnaces (default: [i]true[/i]).[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (version 4.0.0 or higher).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [font=Courier New]VFE[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🌐 Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[/*]
[*]Compatible with multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Compatible with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].[/*]
[*]Full [b]English[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] translations.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]⭐ My Other Mods[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54231][b]Lock Items Mod[/b][/url] — Prevent locked inventory items from transferring to chests when clicking "Add to Existing Stacks".[/*]
[/list]
